name: review_loop
description: Cycles through review prompts from two sources — this project's own docs/prompts/*-review.md, and a local mirror of github.com/maci0/review-prompts' prompts/*-review.md — entirely inside clanker, replacing that repo's review-loop.py as the driver. Actions: {"action":"sync"} mirrors the external repo's prompts/ into state/review-prompts/ (run this first, and again whenever it gains new reviews); {"action":"list"} returns the merged, sorted rotation of review names (a name present in both sources counts once, local wins the resolve); {"action":"next"} advances state/review_loop.json to the following name in rotation and returns its {name, source, path, prompt}; {"action":"current"} returns the same shape for whichever name state/review_loop.json already points at, without advancing. Nothing here runs a review — the caller (a plain clanker run with the returned prompt as the instruction) does that, and repetition comes from clanker schedule, not a loop inside this tool.
llm_description: Cycle review prompts from docs/prompts/*-review.md + a synced mirror of github.com/maci0/review-prompts. {action:sync} mirrors the external repo locally. {action:list} = merged rotation of names. {action:next} advances state and returns {name,source,path,prompt} to run via clanker run. {action:current} = same without advancing.
